text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Happening to come across Silence Suzuka's 
fan interaction event, I decided to take a 
peek inside.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, from here on is the Q&A 
session with Suzuka-san! Let's start with 
the person who raised their hand first!

text_block_list.name: Melancholic Fan
text_block_list.text:
――Suzuka-san, how do you spend your days 
off?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, on my days off... I run.

text_block_list.name: Hesitant Fan
text_block_list.text:
――Um, is there anything you usually do to 
refresh yourself?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Running... I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Timid Fan
text_block_list.text:
――U-Um... well then, what are your 
hobbies...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... but.

text_block_list.name: Timid Fan
text_block_list.text: Oh?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I do like strawberry daifuku.

text_block_list.name: Timid Fan
text_block_list.text: ――I-I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...No matter what was asked, the answer 
was consistently "running." 
Understandably, the enthusiasm of 
questions began to dwindle, but then――

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Fan
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then, um... Suzuka-san... why do 
you "run"?

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whenever you finish a run... you 
always have such a truly wonderful 
expression on your face. I was wondering 
what the root reason behind that might be.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. ...In the end, that's... 
because I love running, yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...There was a time when I thought "I have 
to run because I must win," and that I 
only ran because I had to.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But after meeting so many people and 
running alongside them... I was able to 
remember those initial, pure feelings.

text_block_list.name: Earnest Fan
text_block_list.text:
...Then, what is the single most 
exhilarating moment for you when running?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That would be... when I can see the "view" 
I had hoped for, yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've loved it since long ago. An empty 
road where no one else is... where only 
the sound of my footsteps echoes, running 
with all my heart down that quiet path――

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Truly, truly... that "view" is so 
beautiful―― Even now, it is in pursuit of 
that view that I run in races.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...And right now, there is another thing 
that brings me joy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Through my running, I can show all of you 
who support me a run you've never 
witnessed before... I can show you a 
"view" you've never seen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've come to feel that... doing so is 
truly a wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: Passionate Fan
text_block_list.text: ――Oooh...! Suzuka-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone realized it, the atmosphere 
in the venue had shifted. The audience 
burst into excitement, and new questions 
flew one after another ――all touching upon 
Silence Suzuka's devotion to running.

text_block_list.name: Excited Fan
text_block_list.text:
Does... does the audience you want to show 
that "view" to include us fans too?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... of course. From here on and 
forever, I will keep running in search of 
that "view."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
For myself, and for everyone supporting 
me... I want to show that unseen "view" to 
as many people as possible.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So――please continue to watch over me. 
Watch over... my running――
